column1: # The stock XGIMI phone remote per model (com.xgimi.vcontrol in /vendor/priv-app: LAN discovery on UDP 16752, JSON
# commands on UDP 16750 and TCP 13145, replies to the phone on UDP 16751). Lumen hides /vendor/priv-app, so the
# shared apps/core/lumen-control answers in its place with the values below. Keys on UDP 16735 stay with the vendor
# daemon /vendor/bin/ucontrolMDNS, which runs in Lumen unchanged.
# python3 tools/control/gen_vcontrol.py --write turns this table into VcontrolModels.java, with two facts taken from
# the device registry instead of a copy here: "device" (stock Build.DEVICE = the entry's family, tools/devices/devices.py)
# and autofocus ("focus.af_now" in devices/<c>/menu.json). apps/core/lumen-control/test/run.sh fails when they differ.
# model    the XGIMI model code (ro.boot.xgimi.modelname); every model of devices/*/device.conf has one row
# code     stock vcontrol versionCode, sent as "versioncode" in the connect reply; - = the stock has no vcontrol
#          (then Lumen stays silent too: hide, never fake)
# source   where the row comes from
